chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Walid, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Do not prostrate on gold and do not prostrate on silver."
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray while prostrating on gold or silver surfaces?
ai.summary: This hadith from Sahih al-Tusi specifies that prostration on precious metals like gold and silver is invalid, reflecting the Shia juristic view that these materials are too valuable to be trampled upon. It underscores the principle of *ikram* (honor) in worship, ensuring the place of sajda remains humble and distinct from luxury, thereby preserving the spiritual dignity of the prayer.
